profile.headline: User Input engineer
profile.summary: Developer with a demonstrated history of working in both backend and frontend environments. Skilled in Swift, Objective C, and Python. Graduated from University of Waterloo with a Bachelor's Degree focused in Computer Science and a minor in Cognitive Science.

positions.title: Software Engineer - iOS (AR)
positions.description: Exploring the future of what it means to bring Data to Everything in the Real World with Splunk AR.

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description: Raised the bar for quality on the Augmented Reality Cloud Anchors team. Redesigned the KPI dashboard system to be a direct representation of the key components, implemented new capabilities for benchmarking the localization process, and made launch recommendations for new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer - iOS (AR intern)
positions.description: Explored the possibilities of Augmented Reality, built tools to enhance the capabilities of splunk on mobile, designed and built out a full stack prototype of location based features related to the core capabilities of splunk.

positions.title: Performance Software Engineer
positions.description: Created meaningful signals and dashboards to help developers quickly see performance problems for users in the mobile apps. Optimized iOS app network usage and found the highest impact areas to invest in HTTP/2 upgrades. Contributed to a series of team projects to make it easier to understand the health of services at Yelp, including leading the work on a persisted service dependency graph.

positions.title: Performance Software Engineer
positions.description: Proposed, wrote and reviewed architectural refactors of a distributed context propagation system and a web content delivery strategy framework. Built, improved and used tools which give the ability to monitor degradation of performance, as well as find and fix both performance bottlenecks and easy performance wins. Unified legacy and new photo loading system to save duplicated network calls, significantly reducing latency across all percentiles.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Fixed bugs, refactored code, and added features to the Kik iOS App. Implemented user interfaces using MVVM architecture to make sure UI reacts to changes in the Data layer. Refactored tightly coupled logic into modular and testable classes using Test Driven Development. Corrected internal libraries for Data Structures and fixed synchronization crashes affecting thousands of users.

positions.title: Agile Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built iOS Apps for multiple enterprise level companies such as Pivotal Partner Ford
- Maintained and launched Continuous Integration and Deployment to release nightly builds to QA enabling faster product iteration
- Contributed to an internal module which communicated with hardware and servers to give hardware metrics and access to users
- Developed user interfaces on top of an internal module to present users with location, parking, and engine data

positions.title: Agile Test Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Ensured the quality of mobile apps going to over 40 million users with weekly releases
- Ran regression tests before major releases, smoke tests and exploratory tests on every build
- Wrote tests in Objective C and Bash to automate User Interface testing of apps

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
- Maintained, updated and tested content of websites
- Composed SQL queries to build data sets for generic Business Intelligence analysis
- Installed proprietary software on client server environments

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted teaching the 5-7 year old class.
I gave tours of St. Jerome's University Residence and Academic buildings.

projects.title: MTG Helper App (Swift)
projects.description: Helper App for all things related to Magic the Gathering. Started small as a life counter, and I'm adding features as I go to experiment with iOS patterns, conventions, and new tools.

projects.title: lucashifacts (Bash)
projects.description: Developed a fun little script to send out facts about lucashi. Implemented every free Continuous Integration solution into the project on github, because you can't trust bash.
